title: Gym CRM AC-15
description: Acceptance criterion AC-15 of the Gym CRM (milestone M5).

acceptanceCriteria.text: "Đã tập" and no-show reduce sessions left by exactly 1 and credit the PT; "Hủy lịch" and delete do not; each status shows its color; booking is refused when no sessions are left, the contract has expired, or times overlap.
